newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Enron estimates reduced.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Enron estimates reduced.

text.p: CS First Boston said on Tuesday it reduced its earnings estimates on the shares of Enron Corp for both 1997 and 1998, but maintained its buy rating and $50-per-share target price on the stock.
-- The firm said it lowered its 1997 earnings estimate to $2.25 per share from $2.40 per share and its 1998 earnings estimate to $2.25 per share from $2.85 per share.
-- Further details were not immediately available.

-- Enron Corp said it revised its earnings targets for 1997 by about $0.30 per share to about $2.25 per share on a primary basis. The company said this projection was exclusive of a previously announced J-block settlement of $1.81 per share and a $0.30 per share charge to reflect depressed methyl tertiaty butyl ether (MBTE) margins.
